tools.name: get_publica_now_pricing
tools.description: Return what Publica Now charges a creator: the platform percentage, the fixed per-transaction fee, and the date those rates took effect. There is no monthly fee.

tools.name: list_publica_now_agent_resources
tools.description: List every Publica Now machine-readable entry point: the API, both MCP servers, the authentication endpoints, the sandbox, and the documentation addresses.

tools.name: search_publica_now
tools.description: Search the Publica Now catalog of independently published ebooks, audiobooks, music, and other creator works by title, topic, or creator name. Returns matching works with their canonical URLs.

query.description: Words to search for: a title, a topic, or a creator's name.
